setting.name: LIBERO · Spatial / Object / Goal / … · FWT
setting.tasks: 10 sequential tasks per downstream suite; 4 suites
setting.split: Spatial / Object / Goal / Long; sequential lifelong learning
setting.metric: FWT (lifelong score, not final task success)
setting.protocol: 正式PDF §5.1 Eq.(3)，0–50 epoch每5轮评估，共11检查点，按首次最佳检查点处理学习曲线；三种子均值±标准误。Table1–2相同ResNet-T重复项只记录一次。FWT/AUC越高越好、NBT越低越好；不乘100，不与套件微调成功率混排。
